name: Animated Portfolio Gallery
summary: Portfolio gallery CodeComponent with advanced Framer Motion animations. Features a grid of project cards with staggered entrance (initial/animate), category filtering via ToggleGroup with AnimatePresence for smooth transitions, whileHover/whileTap effects, layout animation for smooth reflow, layoutId for shared element dialog transitions, and useMotionValue-style parallax mouse tracking on the hero section. Nine portfolio items across web, mobile, and design categories. Uses Motion.div, motion.div, Card, ToggleGroup, Badge, Dialog, and Icons from the SDK.
shortSummary: Portfolio gallery with Framer Motion staggered entrance, filtering, and shared element transitions
